test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

Until you confess your crime, the abdomen would ______ to grow and grow until you could not breathe.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e**. 'Continue'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In this context,** the verb **"continue" **is the most suitable choice **because** the sentence is describing a process that will keep on happening (the abdomen growing) until a certain condition (the confession of the crime) is met.
